name: Demon Of Hubris
description: A perfectly beautiful and infinitely cruel demon with a gleaming spear and elegant robes.

abilities.name: Terrifying
abilities.description: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

abilities.name: Double or Nothing
abilities.description: When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.

abilities.name: Unparalleled Skill
abilities.description: Mark a Stress to deal the Demon’s standard attack damage to a target within Close range.

abilities.name: The Root of Villainy
abilities.description: Spend a Fear to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.

abilities.name: You Pale in Comparison
abilities.description: When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.
